scores.scope: Holistic judgment of actually observed emulated mobile experience across both runs, not derived from winning, mission stats, or unassessed features.
scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 playable with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 10 exceptional and consistently effortless within assessed scope.

reasons.overall_mobile: Clear mission flow, atmospheric setting and useful touch assistance supported completion, tempered by imprecise-feeling target retention and crowded combat overlays.
reasons.controls: Manual stick visibly moved forward; brief concurrent movement and FIRE drag worked. Tap aim killed opening guard but moving-target shots and threat-turn taps were less predictable. Brief sample cannot establish sustained manual comfort.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, coil exposure phases and uplink form a legible short mission arc. Rear threats caused damage; much navigation relied on holds, limiting evidence for freeform exploration and continuous combat enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive rain, cool cyan lighting, wet-looking ground and industrial architecture gave the scene a strong atmosphere. Audio and native rendering performance unassessed.
reasons.usability: Large labeled action buttons, contextual hold changes, paused map and explicit end screen were helpful. Boss timing and no-impact feedback required interpretation.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo/objectives were readable and large; small compass/signage and overlapping threat UI reduced easy scene reading.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed but functional, 7 good with noticeable friction, 10 exceptional. Subjective holistic assessment of observed portrait emulation only; wins and game score are not quality grades. Unassessed content contributes no inferred enjoyment. Overall is a judgment, not an arithmetic mean.

overallMobile.reason: Complete, legible mission loop with useful assistance and feedback; dense portrait interface and uncertain moving-target selection reduce confidence in fluid mobile combat.

controls.reason: MOVE, scene swipe, FIRE drag and AIM registered in short samples; large buttons help. A moving guard remained alive after an off-center tap/fire engagement, and full two-thumb coordination remains unassessed.

gameplay.reason: Memory recovery, timed coil vulnerability and uplink give clear progression. Most navigation used assistance, pursuing patrols were often bypassed, and the two runs do not establish sustained combat depth or continuous enjoyment.

presentation.reason: Cohesive rainy teal industrial setting, weapon silhouettes, memory banners and polished result card. Some distant enemies blend with small scene details.

usability.reason: Contextual HOLD ROUTE/APPROACH prompts, auto reload, planning map and clear START FRESH support completion. Threat direction and route guidance sometimes compete; tool actions were not tested.

readability.reason: Health, ammo, main controls, objective changes and terminal results are clear. Compass, navigation and interaction text are small in portrait, while the lower controls occupy much of the view.
